summary.en-US: Open Pixel Camera previews in the gallery you choose

description.en-US:
Pixel Gallery Redirect receives Pixel Camera's photo-preview request and opens
the installed media viewer you choose. Select a gallery once, or choose Ask
every time from the app icon.

The app forwards only the camera's content URI and temporary read access. It
has no network permission, photo-library permission, background service, or
third-party runtime dependencies.

It uses the Google Photos package ID required by Pixel Camera. It cannot be
installed beside Google Photos or another app using that package ID.
